channel.title: Crisp & Counter — buying guides
channel.description: Air-fryer buying guides that check the link before they describe the product.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Two appliances share a name and almost nothing else. Here is the list of differences that actually change how a weeknight goes — and the ones that only look like they do.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air-fryer capacity
item.description: The quart figure on the box answers a question you did not ask. This is the version of the question you did ask.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The appliance that gets used is the one that is easy to put away and easy to wash. Both of those are checkable before you buy.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Multi-function usually means one thing done well and several things done acceptably. The trick is finding out which is which before it takes up a shelf.

item.title: Batch cooking for the week: is one big basket enough?
item.description: The question that decides between a single-basket fryer and a dual-basket one is not capacity. It is how many times you are willing to stand in front of the machine.

item.title: Cooking for guests with one countertop appliance: what actually runs late
item.description: Entertaining is a scheduling problem before it is a cooking problem. Here is where a countertop appliance helps and where it quietly becomes the bottleneck.
